scenes.title: Cold open: Production is on fire
scenes.summary: Red alarms; Chintu announces cloud cost savings because everything is gone.

scenes.title: Meet the DevOps legends
scenes.summary: Mockumentary introductions, ETA montage and tutorial jokes.

scenes.title: The impossible deployment promise
scenes.summary: Manager promises zero downtime and zero risk before lunch.

scenes.title: Chintu receives production access
scenes.summary: Read-only request mistakenly becomes cluster administrator.

scenes.title: The Kubernetes disaster
scenes.summary: Chintu deletes application pods; controllers recreate them but readiness fails.

scenes.title: Emergency bridge call
scenes.summary: Thirty-six attendees, mute confusion and embarrassing screen share.

scenes.title: The Senior investigates
scenes.summary: Senior traces service and ingress routing, discovers wrong backend.

scenes.title: The change approval circus
scenes.summary: Emergency CAB discussion and exaggerated bureaucracy.

scenes.title: The network blame game
scenes.summary: F5, gateway, ingress and service visualized as a packet maze.

scenes.title: ArgoCD strikes back
scenes.summary: Manual hotfix reverts because Git desired state remains incorrect.

scenes.title: The Junior unexpected solution
scenes.summary: Chintu identifies wrong readiness path; GitOps fix deployed.

scenes.title: Production restored
scenes.summary: Green checks, celebration and manager takes credit.

scenes.title: The Terraform twist
scenes.summary: Chintu reveals disaster recovery destroy plan was applied.

scenes.title: Credits and mountain stinger
scenes.summary: Senior receives a new message while resting in Himalayas.
